title: TGPO: Tree-Guided Preference Optimization for Robust Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Ziyuan Chen、Zhenghui Zhao、Zhangye Han、Miancan Liu、Xianhang Ye、Yiqing Li、Hongbo Min、Jinkui Ren、Xiantao Zhang、Guitao Cao
paper_type_zh: Web agent 轨迹构造与偏好优化方法论文
best_for_zh: 研究 environment/agent trajectory data、process reward、偏好学习和 live-web 复现审计的读者
one_line: TGPO merges repeated web-agent episodes into state trees and derives mixed process rewards plus weighted action preferences for offline training, but releases no trajectories, trees, verifier decisions, split manifest, environment snapshot, code, or license.
TGPO 把重复 web-agent episode 合并成 trajectory tree，并生成四项 process reward 与 node-level chosen/rejected action pair；机制可用于研究离线 agent 训练，但未核验到代码、数据、模型、环境快照与许可证的公开发布。
why: It shows how terminal web-task outcomes can be converted into state-action supervision without manual step labels, while exposing a central audit boundary: heuristic state merging and an undisclosed VLM judge can silently determine the preference data, and current official artifacts do not support replay or safe training reuse.
inclusion_reason: TGPO turns repeated web-agent episodes into an explicit derived training object: a merged state-transition tree whose environmental, programmatic, and VLM-judged process signals produce weighted state-action preference pairs. It is valuable for the atlas as a concrete offline agent-trajectory construction recipe, while its missing split, verifier, trajectory, environment, and license artifacts make replay and training reuse unsafe without further release.

title: Problem
问题
html:
TGPO first appeared as arXiv:2509.14172 on 17 September 2025; this Card reads v2 dated 19 September 2025. The same title and author list later entered the ICASSP 2026 proceedings under DOI 10.1109/ICASSP55912.2026.11464574 and was scheduled in the official program for 5 May 2026. The Card therefore preserves the assigned 2025 first-publication year while recording the current formal venue as ICASSP 2026.

The paper addresses a supervision-allocation problem in offline web-agent learning. A complete run usually has only a success/failure label. Assigning that terminal label to every action makes good decisions inside failed runs look negative and poor decisions inside successful runs look positive; manual step annotation is expensive. Sparse terminal feedback also provides little direct pressure against redundant or cyclic interactions.

The source episode is a user instruction followed by web states and actions until success or failure. A state is represented as a screenshot or DOM tree, and actions include click, type, and scroll. The reported task pools contain 300 Online-Mind2Web tasks from 136 real websites and 50 self-constructed C-WebShop Chinese e-commerce tasks from Taobao. Multiple executions of a task are the input to TGPO, but the paper does not disclose the execution count, generator policy, retained episode count, or a serialized row schema.

TGPO belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the trainable object retains instruction, environment state, action, transition, terminal outcome, and a derived state-transition tree. The environment is part of the feedback contract rather than a presentation layer. The paper is not a general release of web trajectories or a replayable browser environment: no raw episodes, merged trees, task manifest, environment snapshot, or terminal-check implementation is available.

Official paper and venue records, the full v2 method, equations, models, task counts, and reported results support L4-depth screening of the mechanism and risks. They do not support an upgrade of the accepted L3_summary_ready metadata level or a claim of reusable data. Code, data, model checkpoints, project assets, environment package, and license remain unverified.

TGPO 于 2025 年 9 月 17 日以 arXiv:2509.14172 首次公开；本卡阅读的是 2025 年 9 月 19 日的 v2。同一标题与作者名单后来以 DOI 10.1109/ICASSP55912.2026.11464574 进入 ICASSP 2026 proceedings，并在官方日程中安排于 2026 年 5 月 5 日展示。因此，本卡按约定保留 2025 首发年份，同时把当前正式 venue 记为 ICASSP 2026。

论文处理的是离线 web-agent 学习中的监督分配问题。完整运行通常只有 success/failure 标签；若把终止标签赋给每个 action，失败轨迹中的好决策会被视为负例，成功轨迹中的差决策会被视为正例，而人工 step annotation 成本较高。稀疏终止反馈也很难直接抑制冗余或循环交互。

源 episode 由 user instruction、连续 web state 与 action 组成，直至成功或失败。state 表示为 screenshot 或 DOM tree，action 包括 click、type 和 scroll。论文报告的任务池包含来自 136 个真实网站的 300 个 Online-Mind2Web 任务，以及 50 个从 Taobao 自建的中文电商 C-WebShop 任务。同一任务的多次执行构成 TGPO 输入，但执行次数、generator policy、保留 episode 数量和序列化 row schema 均未披露。

TGPO 属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为其可训练对象保留 instruction、environment state、action、transition、terminal outcome 和派生的 state-transition tree；environment 是反馈契约的一部分，而不是展示层。论文不是通用 web trajectory 发布，也没有提供可 replay 的浏览器环境：raw episode、merged tree、任务清单、environment snapshot 与 terminal-check 实现均不可用。

官方论文与 venue 记录、完整 v2 方法、公式、模型、任务数量和作者报告结果，足以支持对机制与风险进行 L4 正文深度的筛选；它们不支持升级 accepted metadata 的 L3_summary_ready 等级，也不支持声称数据可复用。代码、数据、模型 checkpoint、项目资产、环境包和许可证均未核验。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is to convert repeated linear web-agent episodes into a trajectory merge tree, attach mixed process feedback to its action branches, and optimize node-local action preferences instead of copying one terminal label onto every step.

TGPO aggregates trajectories for the same task into a tree whose nodes are unique web states and whose edges are actions. Two states are merged when their standardized URLs match—with essential parameters retained—and either their effective action sequences after the URL change agree or their image hashes are identical. This derived object exposes shared prefixes, divergent decisions, correction paths, and cycles across successful and failed executions.

Each branch receives four process signals. The subgoal term is R_subgoal = L_min / (d(s0,st) + min_q d(st,q_goal)); the redundancy term is -1 when a state cycle is detected and 0 otherwise; action accuracy is +1 when an undisclosed VLM judges that the expected interface modification occurred and 0 otherwise; format validity is +1 for a syntactically valid action and 0 otherwise. They combine as R = R_acc + R_format + R_red + alpha * R_subgoal, with only an empirical alpha range of 2–5 disclosed.

At a tree node, divergent branches are ranked by cumulative reward to produce a node-level (chosen action, rejected action) pair. TGPO applies a DPO-style policy-versus-reference log-ratio margin and weights the pair by |r_w-r_l| / sigma(R_s), emphasizing nodes whose competing actions have different cumulative outcomes. Tie handling, zero-variance safeguards, reward-gap thresholds, pair balancing, and record counts are unknown.

The feedback contract is mixed. Environment transitions and terminal success/failure provide episode evidence; URL/action/hash logic, shortest-path progress, cycle detection, and the action parser provide tree-derived or programmatic signals; the VLM supplies judgment-required action-effectiveness labels. These signals can observe collected transitions, syntactic validity, approximate progress, and a predicted UI change. They cannot establish semantic task correctness at every step, recover unvisited branches, or guarantee that merged states are behaviorally equivalent.

Relative to trajectory-level outcome labeling and ordinary DPO pairs over complete outputs, TGPO moves the preference object to divergent actions at a shared state and derives its ranking from cross-trajectory structure. The paper's KTO-Tree comparison indicates that the tree-derived labels contribute separately from the TGPO weighting, but it does not establish that the unreleased labels are calibrated or portable.

本文的贡献是把同一任务的多条线性 web-agent episode 转换为 trajectory merge tree，在 action branch 上附加混合 process feedback，并优化 node-local action preference，而不是把一个 terminal label 复制到每个 step。

TGPO 把同一任务的多条轨迹聚合为树：node 是唯一 web state，edge 是 action。当两个 state 的标准化 URL 相同（保留 essential parameter），且 URL 变化后的 effective action sequence 相同或 image hash 完全一致时，系统将其合并。这个派生对象能表示成功与失败执行之间的共享前缀、分歧决策、纠正路径和循环。

每条 branch 接收四项 process signal。subgoal 项为 R_subgoal = L_min / (d(s0,st) + min_q d(st,q_goal))；检测到 state cycle 时 redundancy 项为 -1，否则为 0；当一个未披露的 VLM 判断 action 造成了预期界面变化时，action accuracy 为 +1，否则为 0；action 语法有效时 format validity 为 +1，否则为 0。总奖励为 R = R_acc + R_format + R_red + alpha * R_subgoal，论文只披露 alpha 的经验范围为 2–5。

在一个 tree node 上，系统按 cumulative reward 排序分歧 branch，构造 node-level (chosen action, rejected action) pair。TGPO 使用 DPO 风格的 policy/reference log-ratio margin，并用 |r_w-r_l| / sigma(R_s) 加权 pair，使竞争 action 累积结果差异较大的 node 获得更高权重。tie handling、zero-variance safeguard、reward-gap threshold、pair balancing 与记录数量均为 unknown。

反馈契约是混合型的。environment transition 与 terminal success/failure 提供 episode 证据；URL/action/hash 逻辑、shortest-path progress、cycle detection 和 action parser 提供 tree-derived 或 programmatic signal；VLM 提供需要判断的 action-effectiveness label。这些信号能观察已采集 transition、语法有效性、近似进展和预测 UI 变化，但不能在每一步确认语义任务正确性，不能恢复未访问 branch，也不能保证 merged state 在行为上等价。

相较 trajectory-level outcome labeling 和对完整输出构造普通 DPO pair，TGPO 把 preference object 移到共享 state 上的分歧 action，并从跨轨迹结构中得到排序。论文的 KTO-Tree 对比说明 tree-derived label 与 TGPO weighting 可能有可分离贡献，但不能证明这些未发布标签已经校准或可迁移。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are 300 Online-Mind2Web tasks covering 136 real websites and 50 self-constructed C-WebShop Chinese e-commerce tasks from Taobao. In the reported systems, Browser-use is paired with Qwen3-14B for Online-Mind2Web, and SeeAct is paired with Qwen2.5-VL-72B for C-WebShop. The exact task IDs, task split, site snapshots, model revisions, browser versions, and task rights are unknown.

For collection, each task is executed multiple times to obtain terminally successful and failed trajectories. Each episode conceptually stores a user instruction, screenshot-or-DOM states, actions such as click/type/scroll, transitions, and a terminal label. The generator checkpoint, executions per task, decoding parameters, step or time cap, reset/session policy, raw counts, and retention rule are not disclosed.

For tree construction, linear episodes for one task are merged into unique state nodes and action edges. Candidate states must share a standardized URL, retaining essential parameters, and must also share either the effective action sequence after the URL change or an identical image hash. The tree is then used for backtracking intermediate progress, identifying correction behavior, and detecting redundant cycles. URL canonicalization, the definition of an effective action, the image-hash algorithm, and merge-quality evaluation are unavailable.

For feedback, every branch receives: shortest-path subgoal progress; -1 for a detected cycle; +1 when an undisclosed VLM judges the expected UI modification effective; and +1 for valid action format. The total is R_acc + R_format + R_red + alpha*R_subgoal, where alpha is only reported within 2–5. Exact goal-node construction, per-experiment alpha, VLM identity and prompt, expected-change representation, action grammar, and terminal success predicate are not disclosed.

For selection, cumulative branch rewards order divergent actions at the same node into chosen/rejected pairs. A dynamic factor |r_w-r_l| / sigma(R_s) weights high-difference decision points in a DPO-style objective against a reference policy. The method does not specify tie resolution, minimum gap, duplicate removal, branch balancing, pair count, or numerical handling when within-node variance is zero or very small.

For optimization and evaluation, both TGPO and DPO begin from SFT-trained models. All compared optimization methods are trained for 2 epochs on 8 H20 GPUs at learning rate 1e-5. Batch size, optimizer, beta, scheduler, sequence length, random seeds, checkpoint selection, and the SFT recipe are unknown. The paper uses the derived pairs for preference learning and agent training, and reports evaluation on the two task pools; it does not release a trainable dataset.

The output pipeline is therefore: task -> repeated web episodes -> heuristic state merge -> trajectory tree -> four process-reward components -> cumulative branch ranking -> weighted node-level chosen/rejected pair -> SFT-initialized preference update -> task evaluation. Reproduction requires the missing code, raw and processed data, model revisions/checkpoints, immutable browser environments, split manifest, verifier configuration, licenses, and exact training configuration.

输入包括覆盖 136 个真实网站的 300 个 Online-Mind2Web 任务，以及从 Taobao 自建的 50 个中文电商 C-WebShop 任务。在论文报告系统中，Online-Mind2Web 使用 Browser-use 与 Qwen3-14B，C-WebShop 使用 SeeAct 与 Qwen2.5-VL-72B。精确 task ID、任务 split、网站 snapshot、模型 revision、浏览器版本和任务权利均为 unknown。

采集阶段对每个任务执行多次，以获得终止成功与失败轨迹。每个 episode 在概念上包含 user instruction、screenshot 或 DOM state、click/type/scroll 等 action、transition 和 terminal label。generator checkpoint、每任务执行次数、解码参数、step/time cap、reset/session policy、raw count 与 retention rule 均未披露。

tree construction 阶段把同一任务的线性 episode 合并为唯一 state node 与 action edge。候选 state 必须共享保留 essential parameter 的标准化 URL，并且 URL 变化后的 effective action sequence 相同，或 image hash 完全一致。随后使用该树回溯中间进展、识别纠正行为和检测冗余循环。URL canonicalization、effective action 定义、image-hash 算法和 merge-quality evaluation 均不可用。

feedback 阶段为每条 branch 计算四项信号：shortest-path subgoal progress；检测到 cycle 时为 -1；未披露 VLM 判断预期 UI 修改有效时为 +1；action format 有效时为 +1。总奖励为 R_acc + R_format + R_red + alpha*R_subgoal，alpha 只报告在 2–5 范围内。goal-node 构造、每个实验的 alpha、VLM 身份与 prompt、expected-change 表示、action grammar 和 terminal success predicate 均未披露。

selection 阶段按 cumulative branch reward 对同一 node 上的分歧 action 排序，形成 chosen/rejected pair。动态因子 |r_w-r_l| / sigma(R_s) 在相对 reference policy 的 DPO 风格目标中提高高差异决策点的权重。论文没有说明 tie resolution、minimum gap、duplicate removal、branch balancing、pair 数量，或 node 内方差为零/极小时的数值处理。

optimization 与 evaluation 阶段中，TGPO 和 DPO 都从 SFT-trained model 开始。所有对比优化方法训练 2 epochs，使用 8 张 H20 GPU，learning rate 为 1e-5。batch size、optimizer、beta、scheduler、sequence length、random seed、checkpoint selection 和 SFT recipe 均为 unknown。论文把派生 pair 用于 preference learning 与 agent training，并在两个任务池上进行 evaluation；它没有发布可训练 dataset。

完整流程因此是：task -> repeated web episode -> heuristic state merge -> trajectory tree -> 四项 process-reward component -> cumulative branch ranking -> 加权 node-level chosen/rejected pair -> SFT-initialized preference update -> task evaluation。复现需要当前缺失的代码、raw/processed data、模型 revision/checkpoint、不可变浏览器 environment、split manifest、verifier configuration、license 和完整训练配置。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The experiments use Browser-use with Qwen3-14B on 300 Online-Mind2Web tasks from 136 websites and SeeAct with Qwen2.5-VL-72B on 50 C-WebShop tasks. All compared optimization methods use 2 epochs, 8 H20 GPUs, and learning rate 1e-5. The paper does not disclose seeds or uncertainty intervals, so the reported values are single-study author results rather than independently reproduced estimates.

On Online-Mind2Web, Table 1 reports TGPO at 38.4% success, 10.71 average steps, and 2.52 redundant steps. DPO reports 34.0%, 11.53, and 2.88 under the same table. On C-WebShop, TGPO reports 78.6% success, 8.66 average steps, and 0.97 redundant steps; DPO reports 72.1%, 9.85, and 1.41. These comparisons support the narrower claim that the reported TGPO system improves success and interaction efficiency relative to the paper's DPO implementation in those settings.

Table 2 reports raw trajectory label-conflict rates of 38.71% for Online-Mind2Web and 26.95% for C-WebShop. This measurement motivates node-level supervision: the same or merged state can be followed by actions inside trajectories with different terminal outcomes. The paper does not release the denominators, conflict records, or detection implementation, so the rates cannot be independently audited.

The KTO-Tree ablation improves over KTO on both datasets. As a curator interpretation, that comparison supplies some evidence that tree-derived step labels matter independently of the TGPO dynamic weighting. It does not fully isolate state merging from all other implementation choices, and the underlying trees and labels are unavailable.

The evidence remains bounded to two web-agent stacks and 350 reported tasks. There is no released code, trajectory set, tree, process-reward record, chosen/rejected pair file, checkpoint, environment snapshot, or independent rerun. The paper also does not report state-merge precision/recall, VLM-judge calibration, sensitivity to alpha, reward-weight robustness, or a train/evaluation overlap audit.

The benchmark results are not evidence that the derived data is high quality. They measure the final systems under the authors' undisclosed implementation. Data quality would additionally require record-level lineage, verifier error analysis, split and contamination controls, failed-example retention, release versioning, and rights information, all of which remain missing.

实验在 300 个 Online-Mind2Web 任务、136 个网站上使用 Browser-use 与 Qwen3-14B，并在 50 个 C-WebShop 任务上使用 SeeAct 与 Qwen2.5-VL-72B。所有对比优化方法均训练 2 epochs、使用 8 张 H20 GPU、learning rate 为 1e-5。论文没有披露 random seed 或 uncertainty interval，因此这些数值是单项研究中的作者报告结果，而不是独立复现估计。

Table 1 中，Online-Mind2Web 上 TGPO 的 success 为 38.4%，average steps 为 10.71，redundant steps 为 2.52；同表 DPO 分别为 34.0%、11.53 和 2.88。C-WebShop 上 TGPO 分别为 78.6%、8.66 和 0.97，DPO 分别为 72.1%、9.85 和 1.41。这些比较支持一个较窄结论：在论文设定下，TGPO 系统相对其 DPO 实现提高了成功率和交互效率。

Table 2 报告 raw trajectory label-conflict rate：Online-Mind2Web 为 38.71%，C-WebShop 为 26.95%。这一测量支持 node-level supervision 的动机：相同或 merged state 后的 action 可能位于 terminal outcome 不同的轨迹中。论文没有发布 denominator、冲突记录或 detection implementation，因此这些比例无法独立审计。

KTO-Tree ablation 在两个 dataset 上均优于 KTO。作为 curator interpretation，这一比较提供了一些证据，说明 tree-derived step label 的作用可以与 TGPO dynamic weighting 部分区分；但它没有完全隔离 state merging 与所有其他实现选择，而且底层 tree 与 label 不可用。

证据范围仅限两个 web-agent stack 和总计 350 个报告任务。当前没有代码、trajectory set、tree、process-reward record、chosen/rejected pair 文件、checkpoint、environment snapshot 或独立 rerun。论文也没有报告 state-merge precision/recall、VLM-judge calibration、alpha sensitivity、reward-weight robustness 或 train/evaluation overlap audit。

benchmark 结果不能证明派生数据质量高。它们测量的是作者未完整披露实现下的最终系统。判断数据质量还需要逐记录 lineage、verifier error analysis、split 与 contamination control、失败样本保留、release versioning 和权利信息，而这些项目仍然缺失。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is to supervise each web-agent action with the success or failure of its whole trajectory, or to form preferences at the level of complete outputs. That treatment loses the fact that a failed episode can contain useful actions and a successful episode can contain redundant or incorrect intermediate actions.

TGPO changes the data object before changing the optimizer. It merges repeated runs of the same task into a state-transition tree, then derives supervision at a shared decision node. The record consumed by preference learning is not merely a successful versus failed episode; it is a state, two divergent actions, their cumulative branch rewards, a chosen/rejected ordering, and a reward-gap/within-node-variance weight.

The feedback interface is also more explicit than a terminal bit. Four components represent approximate subgoal progress, cycle redundancy, VLM-judged action effectiveness, and action-format validity. This decomposition lets the method distinguish progress, syntax, interface effect, and repeated-state behavior, while keeping the terminal episode outcome as a separate signal.

The trajectory merge tree, shortest-path calculation, cycle detection, VLM judging, action parser, SFT initialization, and DPO-style reference-policy objective are not individually new components. The concrete change is their use to construct node-level preference records from cross-trajectory conflicts and to weight decision points by the separation between branch rewards. The work is therefore a construction-and-selection recipe, not an open trajectory dataset or a new environment.

The label-conflict measurements and KTO-Tree ablation are the paper's relevant quality signals, but neither proves that state merges, VLM decisions, or preference pairs are correct. The reported benchmark gains may come from the derived supervision, weighting, implementation details, or their interaction; absent data and code prevent finer attribution.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is that repeated agent episodes can be reorganized around shared states before preference construction. Reuse requires verifying the merge function, terminal checks, all four reward components, pair-selection edge cases, task splits, failed-trajectory retention, and immutable artifacts. Without those checks, the novelty can be studied as a recipe but not treated as a reusable release.

既有基线通常用整条 web-agent trajectory 的 success/failure 监督其中每个 action，或在完整输出层面形成 preference。这种处理会忽略：失败 episode 可能包含有用 action，而成功 episode 也可能包含冗余或错误的中间 action。

TGPO 先改变数据对象，再改变 optimizer。它把同一任务的重复运行合并为 state-transition tree，并在共享 decision node 上派生监督。preference learning 消费的记录不只是成功与失败 episode，而是 state、两个分歧 action、各自 cumulative branch reward、chosen/rejected 排序，以及 reward-gap/within-node-variance 权重。

反馈接口也比 terminal bit 更明确。四个 component 分别表示近似 subgoal progress、cycle redundancy、VLM 判断的 action effectiveness，以及 action-format validity。该分解使方法能够区分进展、语法、界面效果和重复状态行为，同时把 terminal episode outcome 保留为独立信号。

trajectory merge tree、shortest-path calculation、cycle detection、VLM judging、action parser、SFT initialization 和 DPO 风格 reference-policy objective 都不是各自独立的新组件。具体变化在于：利用它们从跨轨迹冲突构造 node-level preference record，并按 branch reward 的分离程度加权 decision point。因此，该工作是 construction-and-selection recipe，而不是开放 trajectory dataset 或新 environment。

label-conflict measurement 与 KTO-Tree ablation 是论文中相关的 quality signal，但二者都不能证明 state merge、VLM decision 或 preference pair 正确。作者报告的 benchmark gain 可能来自派生监督、weighting、实现细节或它们的交互；缺少数据与代码使进一步 attribution 不可行。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，其方向信号是：构造 preference 前，可以围绕共享 state 重新组织重复 agent episode。复用前必须核验 merge function、terminal check、四项 reward component、pair-selection edge case、task split、失败轨迹保留和不可变 artifact。若这些检查未完成，只能把新意作为 recipe 研究，不能把它当作可复用发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The state merge is a consequential heuristic rather than a validated equivalence relation. Standardized URLs, post-change effective action sequences, and image hashes can falsely merge pages that look similar but differ in hidden state, user account, cart contents, timing, or available controls; they can also fail to merge semantically equivalent pages. Such errors propagate into conflict detection, cycles, shortest paths, all process rewards, and chosen/rejected labels. This is a curator inference grounded in the disclosed merge rule; the paper provides no merge-quality evaluation.

The action-accuracy component depends on an undisclosed VLM. Its model, revision, prompt, expected-interface-change representation, calibration set, adjudication, and error analysis are unknown. A false positive or negative can be amplified when the resulting branch has a large reward gap. Format reward can favor syntactic validity without usefulness, and the cycle penalty can punish intentional revisiting or recovery. Shortest-path progress may penalize necessary verification, accessibility, or safety steps. These are curator-inferred failure modes; no reward-attack or sensitivity study is reported.

The preference objective has unresolved numerical and selection behavior. The paper does not disclose beta, pair counts, tie rules, minimum gaps, duplicate handling, balancing, or safeguards when sigma(R_s) is zero or very small. Alpha is only bounded to 2–5 rather than fixed per experiment. Optimizer, batch size, scheduler, sequence limit, seeds, checkpoint selection, and the preceding SFT recipe are also unknown.

Data and evaluation lineage cannot be audited. No task IDs or train/dev/test map establish whether the same or near-duplicate tasks enter SFT, tree construction, preference optimization, model selection, and final evaluation. Raw trajectory counts, success/failure balance, dropped records, tree sizes, pair counts, and record-level provenance are absent. The reported 38.71% and 26.95% conflict rates therefore cannot be traced back to released records.

Exact replay is blocked by missing artifacts: no code, task files, raw or processed trajectories, trees, verifier decisions, chosen/rejected pairs, model checkpoints, browser or environment image, terminal-check implementation, configuration, or release tag was verified. Browser-use and SeeAct versions, website snapshots, cookies, authentication, reset semantics, and browser state are unknown, while live websites and Taobao can drift independently of the method.

Rights and privacy are unresolved. No code, data, model, environment, or C-WebShop license was verified; paper access does not grant reuse rights for screenshots, DOM content, Taobao tasks, generated trajectories, or model outputs. The paper does not discuss credentials, personal-data handling, consent, terms of service, or redaction. Results from two stacks and 350 reported tasks also do not establish robustness across websites, agents, models, or time, and no independent reproduction was found in the confirmed artifacts.

state merge 是影响后续全部标签的启发式规则，而不是经过验证的 equivalence relation。标准化 URL、URL 变化后的 effective action sequence 与 image hash 可能错误合并外观相似但 hidden state、用户账户、购物车内容、时序或可用控件不同的页面，也可能漏合并语义等价页面。错误会传播到 conflict detection、cycle、shortest path、全部 process reward 与 chosen/rejected label。这是基于公开 merge rule 的 curator inference；论文没有提供 merge-quality evaluation。

action-accuracy component 依赖未披露的 VLM。其模型、revision、prompt、expected-interface-change 表示、calibration set、adjudication 与 error analysis 均为 unknown。false positive 或 false negative 在造成较大 reward gap 时可能被动态权重放大。format reward 可能奖励语法有效但无用的 action，cycle penalty 可能惩罚有意 revisit 或 recovery，shortest-path progress 也可能惩罚必要的验证、accessibility 或 safety step。这些是 curator inference；论文没有报告 reward attack 或 sensitivity study。

preference objective 的数值与 selection 行为尚不明确。论文没有披露 beta、pair 数量、tie rule、minimum gap、duplicate handling、balancing，或 sigma(R_s) 为零/极小时的 safeguard。alpha 只给出 2–5 范围，没有给出每个实验的固定值。optimizer、batch size、scheduler、sequence limit、seed、checkpoint selection 与前置 SFT recipe 同样为 unknown。

数据与评测 lineage 无法审计。没有 task ID 或 train/dev/test map 能证明 SFT、tree construction、preference optimization、model selection 与 final evaluation 之间不存在同任务或近重复任务复用。raw trajectory count、success/failure balance、dropped record、tree size、pair count 与逐记录 provenance 均缺失。因此，38.71% 和 26.95% 的冲突率无法追溯到公开记录。

精确 replay 被缺失 artifact 阻断：未核验到代码、task file、raw/processed trajectory、tree、verifier decision、chosen/rejected pair、model checkpoint、浏览器或 environment image、terminal-check 实现、配置或 release tag。Browser-use 与 SeeAct 版本、网站 snapshot、cookie、authentication、reset semantics 与 browser state 均为 unknown，而 live website 与 Taobao 会独立于方法发生漂移。

权利与隐私仍未解决。代码、数据、模型、环境和 C-WebShop license 均未核验；访问论文不等于获得 screenshot、DOM content、Taobao 任务、生成轨迹或 model output 的复用权。论文没有讨论 credential、personal-data handling、consent、terms of service 或 redaction。两个 stack 和总计 350 个报告任务也不能证明跨网站、agent、模型或时间的 robustness，confirmed artifact 中没有独立复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within environment_agent_trajectory_data, TGPO is useful as a design pattern for converting repeated episodes into decision-level supervision. A comparable implementation would retain task identity, state and action serialization, transitions, terminal labels, merge evidence, all four reward components, cumulative branch rewards, chosen/rejected actions, dynamic weights, and record-level lineage. This schema makes the hidden transformation from episode outcome to preference record auditable.

The uses actually demonstrated in the paper are limited to an SFT initialization, offline preference learning, web-agent training, and evaluation. The SFT checkpoint is the starting policy; tree-derived node pairs feed the preference objective; the resulting agents are evaluated on Online-Mind2Web and C-WebShop. The paper does not establish any broader training use, and the missing SFT recipe prevents reconstruction of the initialization.

For construction research, the merge-tree recipe can be tested against alternatives: exact environment-state IDs, DOM-diff matching, learned state equivalence, or no merging. Each study should preserve false merges and missed merges, then measure how they change cycles, subgoal distances, reward components, pair rankings, and downstream results. The four reward terms should also be ablated with fixed tasks and compute.

For verifier and selection research, the undisclosed VLM judge can be replaced by a versioned evaluator with a published prompt, expected-change schema, calibration set, and adjudication policy. Pair construction should log ties, zero-variance nodes, reward gaps, duplicates, and dropped branches. These records would permit false-positive/false-negative analysis and reveal whether high dynamic weights amplify judge or merge errors.

For evaluation, the reported success, average-step, redundant-step, and conflict-rate measurements offer comparison targets only after task and environment versions are pinned. A defensible follow-up must separate training, model selection, and evaluation tasks; replay terminal predicates; report multiple seeds; and compare under the disclosed 2-epoch, 8-H20, 1e-5 budget or a clearly documented alternative.

The present reuse class is blocked pending verification. The Card can support reading, implementation planning, and audit design, but no training or evaluation asset can be safely reused because code, data, models, environment snapshots, task/split manifests, licenses, and replay metadata are all absent.

在 environment_agent_trajectory_data 轨道中，TGPO 可作为把重复 episode 转换为 decision-level supervision 的设计模式。可比实现应保留 task identity、state/action serialization、transition、terminal label、merge evidence、四项 reward component、cumulative branch reward、chosen/rejected action、dynamic weight 和逐记录 lineage，使从 episode outcome 到 preference record 的隐藏转换可被审计。

论文实际展示的用途仅限 SFT initialization、离线 preference learning、web-agent training 和 evaluation。SFT checkpoint 是起始 policy，tree-derived node pair 进入 preference objective，所得 agent 在 Online-Mind2Web 与 C-WebShop 上评测。论文没有建立更广泛的训练用途，而且缺失的 SFT recipe 阻止重建 initialization。

对 construction research，可以将 merge-tree recipe 与 exact environment-state ID、DOM-diff matching、learned state equivalence 或 no merging 对比。每项研究都应保留 false merge 与 missed merge，并测量其对 cycle、subgoal distance、reward component、pair ranking 和下游结果的影响；四项 reward term 也应在固定任务与计算预算下做 ablation。

对 verifier 与 selection research，可以用版本化 evaluator 替代未披露 VLM judge，并公开 prompt、expected-change schema、calibration set 和 adjudication policy。pair construction 应记录 tie、zero-variance node、reward gap、duplicate 与 dropped branch，使 false-positive/false-negative analysis 成为可能，并检查高 dynamic weight 是否放大 judge 或 merge error。

对 evaluation，作者报告的 success、average-step、redundant-step 与 conflict-rate 只能在 task 和 environment version 固定后作为比较目标。可靠后续研究必须隔离 training、model selection 与 evaluation task，replay terminal predicate，报告多个 seed，并使用已披露的 2-epoch、8-H20、1e-5 预算，或清楚记录替代配置。

当前复用等级为 blocked pending verification。本卡可用于阅读、实现规划与 audit design，但不能安全复用任何训练或评测资产，因为代码、数据、模型、environment snapshot、task/split manifest、license 和 replay metadata 全部缺失。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the chronology explicit: arXiv v1 was public in 2025, while the formal publication is ICASSP 2026; the assigned ID and year follow first public release.
  • Read Sections 2.1–2.3 with Figures 1–2: repeated episodes become a merged state tree, four process rewards rank divergent branches, and each node yields a weighted chosen/rejected action pair.
  • Keep the four signals separate: shortest-path subgoal progress, -1 cycle penalty, undisclosed-VLM action effectiveness, and action-format validity do not have the same reliability or observability.
  • Keep the disclosed scale and budget exact: 300 Online-Mind2Web tasks from 136 websites plus 50 C-WebShop tasks; 2 epochs, 8 H20 GPUs, and learning rate 1e-5. Neither task split nor trajectory/pair count is reported.
  • Treat Table 1 and Table 2 as author-reported system evidence, not proof of data quality; verify code, data, model, environment, split, terminal checks, VLM contract, licenses, and replay artifacts before reuse.

• 时间线必须写清：arXiv v1 在 2025 年公开，正式发表 venue 是 ICASSP 2026；assigned ID 与 year 按首次公开时间确定。
  • 应对照阅读第 2.1–2.3 节与 Figure 1–2：重复 episode 先变成 merged state tree，四项 process reward 对分歧 branch 排序，每个 node 再产生加权 chosen/rejected action pair。
  • 四类信号不能混为一谈：shortest-path subgoal progress、-1 cycle penalty、未披露 VLM 的 action effectiveness 与 action-format validity 具有不同的可靠性和可观测范围。
  • 规模与预算必须写准：来自 136 个网站的 300 个 Online-Mind2Web 任务，加 50 个 C-WebShop 任务；训练 2 epochs、使用 8 张 H20 GPU、learning rate 为 1e-5。task split 与 trajectory/pair 数量均未报告。
  • Table 1 与 Table 2 只能作为作者报告的系统证据，不能证明数据质量；复用前必须核验代码、数据、模型、环境、split、terminal check、VLM contract、license 和 replay artifact。

value.html: The reported task pools are 300 Online-Mind2Web tasks from 136 real websites and 50 self-constructed C-WebShop Chinese e-commerce tasks from Taobao. Exact task IDs, prompts, train/dev/test partitions, source snapshots, collection dates, and rights manifests are not disclosed.

A full web episode contains a user instruction and a sequence of web states and actions. States are encoded as screenshots or DOM trees; actions include click, type, and scroll. TGPO derives a merged state tree, per-branch process rewards, cumulative branch rewards, and node-local chosen/rejected action pairs. No serialized record schema is released.

An agent executes each task multiple times to produce offline trajectories with terminal success/failure labels, but the trajectory-generating policy, model revision, number of attempts, decoding settings, human intervention, and retained/dropped counts are unknown.

Browser-use with Qwen3-14B is reported for Online-Mind2Web, and SeeAct with Qwen2.5-VL-72B for C-WebShop. Browser/environment commits, browser version, live-site snapshots, session state, credentials, reset procedures, observation serialization, and replay containers are unknown.

Mixed process feedback: shortest-path subgoal progress; a -1 cycle penalty; a +1 action-effectiveness reward judged by an undisclosed VLM; a +1 action-format reward; and an empirical subgoal coefficient alpha in [2,5]. Cumulative branch rewards rank actions into chosen/rejected pairs, and TGPO weights each pair by its reward gap divided by within-node reward standard deviation.

Trajectories carry success/failure labels and experiments report success rate, but exact per-site success assertions, timeout or maximum-step rules, failure taxonomy, and stop-reason records are unknown.

Named task pool -> repeated agent trajectories -> heuristic state merging -> trajectory tree -> four-component process reward -> cumulative branch ranking -> weighted chosen/rejected state-action pair -> SFT-initialized TGPO update. No record-level lineage manifest is released.

At a merged state node, two divergent action branches are ordered by cumulative reward to form a chosen/rejected action pair; a reward-gap/within-node-variance weight prioritizes high-impact decisions. Tie handling, zero-variance safeguards, minimum gap, pair sampling, and pair counts are unknown.
Qwen3-14B in Browser-use for Online-Mind2Web and Qwen2.5-VL-72B in SeeAct for C-WebShop; exact model repository revisions and checksums are not disclosed.
unknown; the paper states that each task is executed multiple times to collect trajectories but does not identify a trajectory-generating checkpoint or policy.
Online-Mind2Web (300 tasks, 136 websites) and self-constructed C-WebShop (50 Chinese Taobao e-commerce tasks). Exact task files and split manifest are unavailable.

Multiple executions per task produce success/failure trajectories. Attempt count, decoding strategy, temperature, top-p, maximum steps, concurrency, browser/session reset, and seeds are not disclosed.

Merge semantically equivalent states into a tree when standardized URLs match and either post-URL-change effective action sequences agree or image hashes match; use the tree for backtracking, cycle detection, shortest-path progress, and action-branch comparison.
unknown

Tree analysis identifies redundant/cyclic actions and converts divergent action branches into reward-ranked pairs. Exact removal policy, tie rule, minimum reward gap, balancing, deduplication, and success/failure retention policy are not disclosed.
unknown

TGPO and DPO start from SFT-trained models. The TGPO loss uses a DPO-style policy/reference-policy log-ratio margin and a |r_w-r_l|/sigma(R_s) pair weight. All compared RL methods are trained for 2 epochs on 8 H20 GPUs with learning rate 1e-5; optimizer type, beta, batch size, scheduler, sequence length, and checkpoint selection are unknown.

R_red=-1 on detected cycles else 0; R_acc=+1 for VLM-judged effective action else 0; R_format=+1 for valid syntax else 0; total R=R_acc+R_format+R_red+alpha*R_subgoal; alpha is reported only as an empirical range 2-5.
unknown

The paper names 300 Online-Mind2Web tasks from 136 real websites and 50 C-WebShop Chinese e-commerce tasks from Taobao. It does not provide task IDs, source snapshots, collection dates, raw trajectory counts, success/failure counts, tree sizes, preference-pair counts, or mixture weights.
unknown; no train/validation/test map or evidence that evaluation tasks are disjoint from SFT, tree construction, and preference optimization is reported.

unknown; the paper does not disclose whether the same Online-Mind2Web/C-WebShop tasks or near-duplicates appear across trajectory generation, SFT, preference training, checkpoint selection, and final evaluation.
unknown; no task-level or semantic overlap audit, benchmark contamination analysis, model pretraining overlap check, or live-site leakage control is reported.

The method requires successful and failed trajectories to expose cross-trajectory conflicts, but exact retention/drop rules, class balance, rejected traces, tie cases, and before/after counts are not disclosed or released.

items: URL, action-sequence, and image-hash state matching can falsely merge behaviorally different pages or fail to merge equivalent pages, changing conflict detection, cycle detection, shortest paths, rewards, and preference labels.

The action-effectiveness reward depends on an undisclosed VLM judge; false positives or negatives can become high-weight preferences, and no calibration, adjudication, attack, or robustness study is reported.

Shortest-path subgoal rewards may prefer fewer interactions over necessary verification, recovery, accessibility, or safety steps, especially when goal-state distance is only approximated from collected trees.
A format-valid action can earn reward without being semantically useful, while a cycle penalty can punish intentional revisiting or recovery if state identity is coarse.
Reward-gap dynamic weighting can amplify verifier or merge errors at nodes that appear high variance.
Real websites, browser state, authentication, cookies, page content, and UI structure drift over time; no immutable environment snapshot or replay package is released.
Missing train/evaluation splits and task IDs prevent auditing task reuse, near-duplicate leakage, and benchmark overfitting.
No released raw trajectories, trees, pair records, code, checkpoints, or exact hyperparameters permit independent verification of label-conflict rates or reported gains.
